<h1 id="raksha-basic" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>Raksha Basic</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/84XEYnJq1T.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section" data-gear="true">
<h2 id="presets-and-relics"><ins><nowiki>Presets and Relics</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=8tHDhZfEj1qjSLlYnxlU <nowiki>Magic preset</nowiki>]<pvme-image src="https://pvme.io/preset-maker-storage/embeds/images/3c5ed4b971a4b1e3bbf8311d9638030ad91882dfc756d1a3cab82cdb455e0daa.webp" alt="Unnamed preset" kind="addition" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=nbcWVE1htdRe9esuOac6 <nowiki>Ranged preset</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>​
</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FnbcWVE1htdRe9esuOac6.png?alt=media" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="general-knowledge"><ins><nowiki>General Knowledge</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Raksha fight consists of 4 phases, with 200k HP for each phase (400k if duo).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Prayer flicking is crucial and mandatory as Raksha is able to use all three combat styles.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Raksha uses a special attack after every 4 normal attacks during phases 1-3, and after every 2 normal attacks during phase 4.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088769982475.png?v=1" alt="p6" title="p6" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1214416401561952296.png?v=1" alt="er4" title="er4" kind="icon" /><nowiki> on </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903893177106454.png?v=1" alt="lanispear" title="lanispear" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to ensure 1k minimum damage with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1" alt="bd" title="bd" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• To see if you meet the minimum damage requirement, go to dummies at War's Retreat, set them to minimum hit mode, and use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903893177106454.png?v=1" alt="lanispear" title="lanispear" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1" alt="bd" title="bd" kind="icon" /><nowiki> with your Raksha gear.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If you did not meet the requirement, use to </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936606347280.png?v=1" alt="turmoil" title="turmoil" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159416557573.png?v=1" alt="Malevolence" title="Malevolence" kind="icon" /><nowiki> while using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1" alt="bd" title="bd" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="unlocking-raksha"><ins><nowiki>Unlocking Raksha</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="raksha-the-shadow-colossus-miniquest"><nowiki>Raksha, the Shadow Colossus (Miniquest)</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Slayer Cape </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975284344123953164.png?v=1" alt="slayercape" title="slayercape" kind="icon" /><nowiki> tele to Laniakea, speak to her about the door at the top of the ruins.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Go through all the dialogue, then head to the south west, siphon the purple stuff (Takes like 1 minute).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ After siphoning the purple stuff, head in through the door and space bar through dialogue; miniquest complete.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="recommendation"><ins><nowiki>Recommendation</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Due to the nature of Raksha being very prayer-flick reliant, you may find it helpful to practice prayer flicking with nothing but a weapon until death, while doing damage and dealing with mechanics.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Repeat this until you get the hang of prayer flicking under pressure.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>Note: if you are in melee distance, Raksha will not use the same style auto-attack back-to-back</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="raksha-attack-pattern"><ins><nowiki>Raksha Attack Pattern</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/b37wb1r.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="mechanics-summary"><ins><nowiki>Mechanics Summary</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="phases-1-3"><nowiki>Phases 1-3</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><ins><nowiki>Rockfall</nowiki></ins></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Happens between phases 1-3 transitions.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 5x5 rocks fall from the ceiling that deal heavy typeless damage.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Small rubbles indicate the spots rocks will fall on.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Move out of the way before rocks hit the floor.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Utilise </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1" alt="powerburstofvitality" title="powerburstofvitality" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1" alt="disrupt" title="disrupt" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><ins><nowiki>Tail Swipe and Charge</nowiki></ins></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Tail Swipe</nowiki></strong><nowiki> → If the player is in melee distance → Raksha spins around in a 3x3 radius.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Charge</nowiki></strong><nowiki> → If the player is outside of melee distance → Raksha charges towards the player.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Getting hit by either of those attacks results in heavy typeless damage and a stun.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Remain in melee distance to avoid getting a Charge attack.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Run out of spin radius once Raksha starts the Tail Swipe animation.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><ins><nowiki>Shadow Bomb</nowiki></ins></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Raksha stuns the player before launching a shadow bomb that explodes and leaves a poison cloud in a 3x3 radius.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Raksha launches 3 bombs in phase 3.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1" alt="anti" title="anti" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1" alt="freedom" title="freedom" kind="icon" /><nowiki> beforehand to protect against the stun.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Move out of the bomb's radius before it lands.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><ins><nowiki>5X Shockwave</nowiki></ins></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Raksha walks to the middle of the room and unleashes 5 strong magic attacks.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Phase Raksha before he can reach this special attack.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Restart the fight if you receive said special attack.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><ins><nowiki>Mind Poison</nowiki></ins></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Raksha immobilizes the player and spawns 2-5 orbs that deal constant typeless damage.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Failure of expelling the orbs will result in heavy typeless damage.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Click the orbs to expel them.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Clicking the orbs does </nowiki><strong><nowiki>not</nowiki></strong><nowiki> interrupt combat or channeled abilities.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><ins><nowiki>Shadow Anima Pools</nowiki></ins></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Harmless 1k HP pools that spawn in 4 different areas.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• During phase 3, Raksha absorbs anima from said pools.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ At the start of phase 3, kill all pools with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903893177106454.png?v=1" alt="lanispear" title="lanispear" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/602581988599398400.png?v=1" alt="Laceration" title="Laceration" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1" alt="bd" title="bd" kind="icon" /><nowiki> before Raksha can absorb any anima.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>DO NOT</nowiki></strong><nowiki> use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1" alt="bd" title="bd" kind="icon" /><nowiki> during global cooldown as it will deal no damage.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1" alt="bd" title="bd" kind="icon" /><nowiki> on the pool highlighted in green (using it on the pools in red will not guarantee all pools in the vicinity being cleared)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/4hSPQGW.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><ins><nowiki>Minion Spawn</nowiki></ins></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Exclusive to phase 3.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Raksha spawns a 10k HP melee minion during Mind Poison.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Pray </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1" alt="DeflectMelee" title="DeflectMelee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> against minion when Raksha isn't attacking, and focus on phasing Raksha.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="phase-4"><nowiki>Phase 4</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Raksha heals up to 400k HP.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><ins><nowiki>Tail Swipe and Shadow Bomb</nowiki></ins></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Tail Swipe</nowiki></strong><nowiki> → If the player is in melee distance.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Shadow Bomb</nowiki></strong><nowiki> → If the player is outside of melee distance.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Stand anywhere on the red lines to force Tail Swipes.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/Tw4qZsT.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><ins><nowiki>Erebus Charge</nowiki></ins></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Exclusive to phase 4.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Raksha stops attacking and covers himself in a blue dome.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Deal enough damage to break the dome.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ The dome's health scales with how much anima Raksha previously absorbed from phase 3.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><ins><nowiki>Inner Power</nowiki></ins></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Extra action button, exclusive to phase 4.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Available after Erebus Charge special attack.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Upon activation, increase your damage by 10% for each shadow anima you collected.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><ins><nowiki>Shadow Anima</nowiki></ins></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Exclusive to phase 4.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• After destroying the blue dome during Erebus Charge, collectable shadow anima drop on the ground.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Collect 6-12 anima before activating Inner Power.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="basic-rotations"><ins><nowiki>Basic Rotations</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="ranged"><nowiki>Ranged</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>Note: If you do not own the </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626404171786.png?v=1" alt="igneouskalxil" title="igneouskalxil" kind="icon" /><nowiki> cape, use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1215929540908679208.png?v=1" alt="zammybow" title="zammybow" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> instead of </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541307666595870.png?v=1" alt="deadshot" title="deadshot" kind="icon" /></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="phase-1"><nowiki>Phase 1:</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903893177106454.png?v=1" alt="lanispear" title="lanispear" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/602581988599398400.png?v=1" alt="Laceration" title="Laceration" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → clear pools with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1" alt="bd" title="bd" kind="icon" /><nowiki> after all rocks fall.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921597813137518.png?v=1" alt="deathsswiftpf" title="deathsswiftpf" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339233638023179.png?v=1" alt="limitless" title="limitless" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535534127131394088.png?v=1" alt="snap" title="snap" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1" alt="rapid" title="rapid" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1215929540908679208.png?v=1" alt="zammybow" title="zammybow" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /></p>

<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Prioritise using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535534127131394088.png?v=1" alt="snap" title="snap" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1" alt="rapid" title="rapid" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1215929540908679208.png?v=1" alt="zammybow" title="zammybow" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> in that order</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Collect anima after dome breaks, utilise </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1" alt="anti" title="anti" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1" alt="freedom" title="freedom" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1" alt="res" title="res" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>⬥ Inner Power → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/959089455283728386.png?v=1" alt="deadshotigneous" title="deadshotigneous" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535534127131394088.png?v=1" alt="snap" title="snap" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1" alt="rapid" title="rapid" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306294796299.png?v=1" alt="corruptshot" title="corruptshot" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1215929540908679208.png?v=1" alt="zammybow" title="zammybow" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="magic"><nowiki>Magic</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>In general, use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513203008608141314.png?v=1" alt="gstaff" title="gstaff" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> whenever you have excess adrenaline or if you need a little more damage to phase before a certain spec.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="phase-1_1"><nowiki>Phase 1:</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921595489488927.png?v=1" alt="sunshinepf" title="sunshinepf" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1" alt="adrenrenewal" title="adrenrenewal" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/958989794757730307.png?v=1" alt="tsunamiincite" title="tsunamiincite" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1" alt="wm" title="wm" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1" alt="asphyx" title="asphyx" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1179505745654448208.png?v=1" alt="omnipowerigneous" title="omnipowerigneous" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1" alt="wm" title="wm" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1" alt="asphyx" title="asphyx" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>

<h3 id="phase-2_1"><nowiki>Phase 2:</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Use powerful basics, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1" alt="wm" title="wm" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1" alt="asphyx" title="asphyx" kind="icon" /><nowiki> as they come off cooldown.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1179505745654448208.png?v=1" alt="omnipowerigneous" title="omnipowerigneous" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and then </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/958989794757730307.png?v=1" alt="tsunamiincite" title="tsunamiincite" kind="icon" /><nowiki> as soon as they come off cooldown.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="phase-3_1"><nowiki>Phase 3:</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903893177106454.png?v=1" alt="lanispear" title="lanispear" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/602581988599398400.png?v=1" alt="Laceration" title="Laceration" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → clear pools with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1" alt="bd" title="bd" kind="icon" /><nowiki> after all rocks fall.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921595489488927.png?v=1" alt="sunshinepf" title="sunshinepf" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → basics → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1" alt="wm" title="wm" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1179505745654448208.png?v=1" alt="omnipowerigneous" title="omnipowerigneous" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339233638023179.png?v=1" alt="limitless" title="limitless" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1" alt="asphyx" title="asphyx" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="phase-4_2"><nowiki>Phase 4:</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Refresh </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090641879050.png?v=1" alt="smokecloud" title="smokecloud" kind="icon" /><nowiki> upon entry, use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1" alt="wm" title="wm" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1" alt="asphyx" title="asphyx" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1179505745654448208.png?v=1" alt="omnipowerigneous" title="omnipowerigneous" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/958989794757730307.png?v=1" alt="tsunamiincite" title="tsunamiincite" kind="icon" /><nowiki> while waiting for </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1" alt="sunshine" title="sunshine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> cooldown, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921595489488927.png?v=1" alt="sunshinepf" title="sunshinepf" kind="icon" /><nowiki> when it becomes available.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Quickly collect some anima after dome breaks, usually done by walking to a side of the </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921595489488927.png?v=1" alt="sunshinepf" title="sunshinepf" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and then </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1" alt="bd" title="bd" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to the other side.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Inner Power and try to finish off Raksha while in </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921595489488927.png?v=1" alt="sunshinepf" title="sunshinepf" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
